name: Nagato Yuki de Baozou
source:
[i]Nagato Yuki no Bousou[/i] is a doujin novel of Suzimiya Haruhi series, first posted on the eroparo board on 2ch. It's a story from the first-person point of view of Nagato Yuki, tells people why Nagato Yuki's eventual rampage in [i]Suzumiya Haruhi no Shoushitsu[/i].

The work has been translated into simplified Chinese and circulated on the Internet. In late 2006, RB Agency adapted it into a visual novel and published it on the POPGO forums.
translation:
[i]长门雪之狂想[/i]是凉宫春日系列的同人小说，首次发布在2ch的eroparo板上。这是一个以长门有希的第一人称视角讲述的故事，讲述了长门有希在《[i]凉宫春日的少女[/i]》中最终暴走的原因。

该作品已被翻译成简体中文并在互联网上流传。2006年底，RB Agency将其改编成视觉小说并在POPGO论坛上发布。
